map.板（厚 T）M=T/2；立方体（边长 a）M=a/6；球（径 D）M=D/6；圆: Plate (thickness T) M=T/2; cube (side a) M=a/6; sphere (diameter D) M=D/6; cylinder (diameter D, length L) M=D·L/(2D+4L); rod (section a×b) M=a·b/(2(a+b)); block (a×b×c) M=a·b·c/(2(ab+bc+ca)).
